title: 351 run standalone JBMC on both original runtime closures
description: Following the paired frontend refusal, execute standalone JBMC independently on the old and new ordered adapter/application/dependency classpaths that were bound by the V0 native receipt. Use identical harness bytes per side, true and false original JVM controls, the same original return observer and recorded bounds; preserve all unwind assertions and missing-body diagnostics. This is an assisted per-side engine baseline and cannot count as automated claim selection.
expected: Both actual JBMC invocations have a recorded exit or timeout on verified classpaths. A proof requires complete unwinding and supported library semantics; candidates require independent JVM reproduction.

resources.notes: The two solver processes share the 600-second native search budget. Per-side pressure is unknown on historical libraries, so retain the full 16 GiB ceiling.
